newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Colly Cotton offer to close early.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Colly Cotton offer to close early.

text.p: Stockbrokers County Natwest said on Friday that the intial public share offer for cotton grower Colly Cotton Ltd would close nine days ahead of the schedule on 5.00 p.m. (0700 GMT) October 9.
County Natwest is the underwriter to the offer by Colly Cotton, which plans to raise A$107 million.

County Natwest said the four government superannuation funds, which currently own Colly would subscribe individually for shares in Colly. Their combined participation would be 25 percent of Colly's issued capital.

It said the Kahlbetzer group of companies, which already has substantial cotton interests in Australia and Argentina, would subscribe for 25 percent of Colly, with the first right to purchase any unitholders' share if unitholders wish to sell.
The broker firm said the remaining 50 percent of the shares would be placed with a variety of Australian and offshore institutions and a number of retail brokers.
Colly Farms is based in northwestern New South Wales and is one of Australia's largest cotton producers.

The cotton producer has forecast in its prospectus a net profit of A$21.4 million for the year to June 30, 1997 and pay a full year dividend of 9.7 cents a share in two instalments in April and October 1997.
